column2: Retain sending throughout Israel/Judah, letters to Ephraim/Manasse and invitation to the Jerusalem temple for the Lord's Passover. Inviting makes the infinitival purpose readable without adding a new command formula.
Retain consultation by king, rulers and whole Jerusalem assembly and the second-month date. The timing is a collective decision in the narrative.
Retain inability at that time because too few priests were purified and the people were not assembled. Enough concerns the number of priests rather than inadequate purification of each priest.
Retain approval by both king and assembly. Proposal renders the matter under discussion without introducing a new decree beyond the next verse.
Retain proclamation throughout Israel from Beersabee to Dan, Jerusalem's Passover and a multitude not having observed according to the writing. Do not change multitude into a temporal many years.
column3: The breadth of the negative and whether multitude implies participation in large numbers remain open.

column2: Retain runners, letters, royal command, Abraham/Isaac/Israel and the Lord bringing back survivors left from Assour's king. The return verb takes the survivors as object; it is not simply God returning to them.
Retain fathers and brothers departing from their fathers' God, delivery to devastation and the addressees' sight. The warning includes both ancestral and contemporary family examples.
Retain stiff necks, giving glory, entering the perpetually sanctified sanctuary, service and removal of wrath. Give glory is not changed to give a hand from another textual form.
Retain compassion before all captors, singular divine bringing back and the shift from your brethren to our God/us/we. The selected pronoun shift is not regularized throughout to you.
column3: The unnamed subject of bring back is contextually God; no claim of explicit personal naming is made.

column2: Retain city-to-city travel through Ephraim/Manasse to Zaboulon and mocking reception. People supplies the contextual mockers rather than attributing mockery to the runners.
column3: The Greek's compressed subject transition is an open referential issue.

column2: Retain Aser, Manasse and Zaboulon men feeling shame and coming. Shame is not silently converted into a different humbling verb.
Retain the Lord's hand in Judah giving one heart for coming and acting under king/rulers and the Lord's word. Divine initiative and human ordinance both remain.
Retain great people and very great assembly, Jerusalem, Unleavened Bread and the second month. The double scale expression is not compressed away.

Retain demolition of Jerusalem altars and everything used for incense to the false ones, then disposal in Kedron. Gods supplies the contextual noun of the adjective without replacing the selected characterization.
Retain Passover sacrifice on day fourteen of month two, shame, purification and burnt offerings by priests and Levites. Do not move the purification into an earlier unstated date.
Retain stations, rule, Moses as man of God and priests receiving blood from Levites. The selected clause does not add sprinkling of the blood.
Retain the unpurified multitude and Levites sacrificing for everyone unable to purify himself for the Lord. The inability qualification is not removed.

Retain the four tribal groups, their lack of purification, eating contrary to the writing and Hezekiah's prayer. The third-person May the good Lord requires no Thou, and the sentence continues across the stored verse boundary.
Retain every heart directed to seek the fathers' God and the qualification about purity of the holy places. The cross-verse prayer is not completed by inserting a new verb or diagnosis.
column3: The attachment of the purity qualification and the sense of holy places remain provisional ritual/syntax questions.

column2: Retain the Lord hearing Hezekiah and healing the people. Healing is not replaced with a merely administrative permission to participate.
Retain seven days, great rejoicing, daily hymns and priestly/Levitical instruments for the Lord. Playing supplies the instrumental action contextually; no instrument type is added.

Retain speaking to every heart of Levites and those with good understanding, completing seven days, salvation sacrifices and thanksgiving. The coordinated those who understand is not silently made only an adjective for all Levites.
column3: Every heart and good understanding toward the Lord need further readable and lexical review.

column2: Retain agreement together for another seven days and repeated seven-day rejoicing. The additional period is not confused with the first seven days.
Retain Hezekiah's 1,000 calves/7,000 sheep, rulers' 1,000 calves/10,000 sheep and abundance of the priests' holy things. Do not replace holy things with many priests sanctifying themselves.
column3: The final nominal clause's exact referent remains unresolved and the inherited phrase is provisional.

column2: Retain whole assembly, priests, Levites, Judah assembly, Israelites present, resident foreigners from Israel and residents in Judah. Do not erase repeated assembly or resolve every group into one ethnic category.
Retain great Jerusalem rejoicing and no such festival since Solomon son of David. The selected comparison names a festival, not merely joy without a festival reference.

Retain Levitical priests blessing, their voice heard and prayer reaching His holy dwelling, heaven. The lack of a conjunction between priests and Levites supports the adjectival reading without inventing a second group.

Retain all Israel present in Judah's cities, destruction of pillars/groves/high places/altars across four territories and each returning to inheritance and cities. The source's singular/plural possessive shift remains visible.

Retain priestly and Levitical divisions, each ministry, burnt and salvation offerings, praise, thanksgiving and service at gates in the temple courtyards. Repeated divisions remain rather than implying a new organizational level.
column3: The exact assignment of repeated divisions and sacrificial terminology remains provisional.

column2: Retain the king's portion from his own property for morning/evening, Sabbath, new-moon and festival offerings according to the law. No additional donation amount is supplied.
Retain Jerusalem residents supplying priests and Levites so they grow strong in the house's ministry. Do not substitute devotion to the law for the selected ministry purpose.
Retain firstfruits of grain, wine, oil, honey and every crop, then abundant tithes. The final subject continues in verse 6 and the dash preserves that boundary.

Retain Israel/Judah as the preceding subject, additional Judah-city contributors, tithes of calves/sheep/goats and heaps upon heaps. Goats is explicit, not replaced by a generic tithe of consecrated things.
Retain heaps beginning in month three and completion in month seven. No annual frequency beyond the stated collection is inserted.
Retain king and rulers seeing the heaps and blessing both the Lord and His people Israel. Blessing the people is not silently changed to blessing God for the people.
Retain inquiry of both priests and Levites about the heaps. The question's content is not supplied ahead of the response.
Retain Azarias the priest leading Sadok's house, eating and drinking, repeated remainder and blessing upon the people. Do not replace the explicit drinking with an inferred satisfaction verb.
Retain commanded preparation of chambers and its fulfillment. No unexpressed new building construction is asserted.
Retain faithful delivery of firstfruits/tithes, Chonenias overseeing and Semei succeeding or deputizing under him. No separate holy-things category is imported here.
column3: Deputy is a contextual administrative rendering, not a definite chronological succession claim.

column2: Retain all ten named appointees and his sons, Chonenias/Semei mediation and Hezekiah/Azarias authorization. Banaias's adjacent sons are not omitted to match a shorter list.
column3: Whose sons the pronoun denotes remains provisional rather than independently genealogically verified.

column2: Retain Kore son of Jemna, Levite, eastern gatekeeper, gifts, firstfruits to the Lord and most holy things. Distribution continues through verse 15; no invented closing sentence is inserted.
Retain six named distributors, priests, faithfulness, brethren's divisions and great/small alike. The selected phrase is through the priests, not in the priests' cities.
column3: The repeated through-hand construction and relation of the named distributors to the priests remain open.

column2: Retain the exception/qualification involving male offspring age three and upward, temple entrants, daily account and assigned ministries. Do not change three to thirty or infer that every three-year-old performs temple work.
column3: The exclusion's scope and relation between registered offspring and actual entrants remain unresolved in this provisional syntax.

column2: Retain priestly enrollment by fathers' houses and Levites twenty and upward by appointed divisions. The different age threshold is not harmonized with verse 16.

Retain enrollment, offspring, sons/daughters, the whole multitude and faithful purification of the holy place. Do not insert wives or convert purification of the holy object into explicit self-consecration.
column3: The genitive relations and whether the holy denotes place or object remain open; the cross-verse construction is provisional.

column2: Retain Aaron's priestly sons at the continuation boundary, designated men in each city and portions for every priestly male and enrolled Levite. Do not add pastoral lands absent from the selected wording.
column3: The connection of the initial dative to purification in verse 18 and the following administrators needs further syntax review.

column2: Retain the action throughout Judah and good and right before his God. No additional faithful adjective is imported into the two-part evaluation.
Retain every initiated temple work, law and ordinances, seeking God with the whole soul, acting and prospering. Soul is not silently changed to heart.
